name: Psychopomp High
source:
What would you do if you woke up one day, couldn't remember who you were, and had a whole new role in the universe? Oh, also you’re now attending a high school for grim reapers, and you've just made your first two friends. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28770]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
如果有一天你醒来，不记得自己是谁，并且在宇宙中扮演了一个全新的角色，你会怎么做？哦，还有，你现在在一所死神高中上学，而且你刚刚交了两个朋友。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28770]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
